content.user_title: Create Agent Skills for Claude Code
content.value_statement: Writing a useful Agent Skill requires clear scope, valid frontmatter, and testable instructions. This skill guides authors through structure, examples, validation, and troubleshooting for Claude Code skills.
actual_capabilities: Helps define skill scope, activation triggers, and required resources.
Explains personal and project skill locations for Claude Code.
Shows required SKILL.md frontmatter and effective description patterns.
Outlines clear Markdown sections, examples, requirements, and supporting files.
Provides validation, testing, and troubleshooting checklists.
Shows patterns for read-only, script-based, and multi-file skills.
limitations: It does not include an automated validator or schema parser.
It does not create a security sandbox for generated skills.
It focuses on Claude Code skills and may need adaptation for other agents.
Example commands require user review before execution.

use_cases.title: Create Project Skills
use_cases.description: Build a focused skill for a repository workflow, such as code review, release notes, or data processing.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Guidance
use_cases.description: Turn team conventions into reusable Claude Code instructions with clear activation triggers and validation steps.

use_cases.title: Convert Prompts Into Skills
use_cases.description: Restructure an existing prompt or checklist into a documented skill with examples and supporting files.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner authoring for a single workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me create a Claude Code skill for [workflow]. Ask what the skill should do, when it should activate, and which tools it needs.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Existing Skill Text
prompt_templates.scenario: Review and refine a current SKILL.md file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my SKILL.md for scope, frontmatter, trigger words, examples, and validation issues. Suggest edits before changing files.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Multi-File Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Plan a skill with references, examples, or helper assets.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a multi-file skill for [domain] with SKILL.md, reference material, examples, and optional helper scripts. Explain which files are needed and why.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Activation and Safety
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review before sharing a skill.
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this skill for activation conflicts, tool permissions, filesystem behavior, and confusing instructions. Recommend safer wording and validation checks.

output_examples.input: Create a skill for reviewing database migrations.
output_examples.output: A scoped skill plan with a clear name, activation description, required tools, SKILL.md sections, examples, and testing checklist.

output_examples.input: My skill does not activate in Claude Code.
output_examples.output: A troubleshooting review of description specificity, file location, YAML frontmatter, and activation phrases.

output_examples.input: Convert this workflow into a reusable skill.
output_examples.output: A proposed skill structure with core instructions, optional reference files, examples, requirements, and validation steps.

best_practices: Keep each skill focused on one capability and one clear activation context.
Write descriptions with concrete trigger phrases, file types, and expected operations.
Use tool limits and validation checklists for workflows that touch files or scripts.
anti_patterns: Creating broad skills that try to cover many unrelated workflows.
Leaving frontmatter vague, generic, or disconnected from user trigger phrases.
Adding scripts or dependencies without listing requirements and safety limits.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create Agent Skills for Claude Code, including SKILL.md structure, frontmatter, examples, and validation steps.

faq.question: Can it update an existing skill?
faq.answer: Yes. It can review an existing SKILL.md file and suggest improvements for scope, triggers, structure, and testing.

faq.question: Does it generate helper scripts?
faq.answer: It can explain where helper scripts belong, but the included skill file does not provide script generators.

faq.question: Is it limited to Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. Its guidance is written for Claude Code skill locations, frontmatter, and activation behavior.

faq.question: Does it require network access?
faq.answer: No. The skill content does not require network access or external services.

faq.question: How should authors test a new skill?
faq.answer: They should check file location, validate YAML frontmatter, use specific activation prompts, and confirm Claude follows the instructions.
